jobs.title: Project Officer (all genders) - Negotiation Support to Resistance and Liberation Movements
jobs.reason: The role requires C1-level French as an essential ("Excellent verbal and written language skills in English and in French (at least C1-level)"), which the candidate's B1 French does not meet — a hard disqualifier. This is a shame, as peacebuilding, negotiation support and transitional processes sit squarely in the candidate's core interest zone.
